items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All three ACs met: six rule objects with why, two ESLint fragments, instruction-only rules per decisions 4.3 and 4.4, both API route examples delegate to helpers, duplicated prose removed, fixture tree plus drift test.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unknown ESLint rule in a fragment fails the drift test loudly instead of being skipped; the profile validates with no rule errors or warnings.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Data and docs only; the rule keeps client factories out of component code; no secrets in fixtures.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 43 drift tests: fixture equals template, every TS example mapped, tree passes both fragments, seeded violations flagged, exempt and compliant files not flagged; the U1 tests were updated for the converted profile.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Nothing at runtime; tests read 16 small files.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Rule ids are kebab-case and match the contract; the test file is under 300 lines; fixtures sit beside the tests.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: profile lint fragments; consumer: ESLint (real run with ESLint 10 recorded). The probe found two defects (namespace-import over-flagging, type-only imports), both fixed and re-run clean.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No sleeps, no shared state, read-only access to committed files.
